verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents chart-of-accounts customization: nothing covers creating or editing accounts, account types, sub-accounts, or class dimensions. The only nearby material is Wave's statement that it uses double-entry accounting and a vague homepage line, "Tag it, track it," which does not tie tags to ledger accounts or reporting dimensions. Both are adjacent claims, not this capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
